name: Membrane del principe
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL wide 16:9 full-page painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: A luminous subterranean pool of translucent slimes of different sizes, rounded jelly ripples and floating leaves trapped softly inside them; tiny discarded boots at the edge. Mint, blue and pale pink. Composition: illustrate the whole page naturally, with a quiet darker centre for readable controls, no empty rectangular panels. Matte hand-painted gouache and restrained anime fantasy linework, attractive deliberate shapes, believable construction and materials, detailed but uncluttered, no glossy 3D. The first reference is ONLY for painterly technique; do NOT copy its objects, geography, sunset or lighting. No sun disc, no eye in the sky. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, no currency discs, no Obser, no engraved eyes as generic decorations. Any clouds present naturally in the scene mix luminous BLUE dominant, then INDIGO, VIOLET and PASTEL PINK. Do not force clouds indoors. Tell the story ONLY through image details. NO writing, text, UI, logos, watermarks. Do not repeat the previous theme's composition, relic or environment.
